definitions.explanation: Reproduction in the full range of colors, as opposed to black-and-white or a limited palette. Used of printing, displays, and images.

examples.japanese: フルカラー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{冊子|さっし}→冊子：22374_sasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フルカラー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧やすい。
examples.english: This booklet is in full color and easy to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白黒|しろくろ}→白黒：13642_shirokuro⟧だった⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、フルカラー{版|ばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{復刊|ふっかん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A manga that used to be black-and-white was reissued in a full-color edition.

notes:
A loanword from English "full color," contrasting with ⟦{白黒|しろくろ}→白黒：13642_shirokuro⟧ (black-and-white) or ⟦{単色|たんしょく}→単色：22209_tanshoku⟧ (monochrome). Frequently used of printing, screens, and illustrations. Often used attributively before another noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フルカラー⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧: full-color printing
- フルカラー⟦{液晶|えきしょう}→液晶：16387_ekishou⟧: full-color LCD
- フルカラー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧: to display in full color

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白黒|しろくろ}→白黒：13642_shirokuro⟧: black-and-white — the opposite
- ⟦モノクロ→モノクロ：11226_monokuro⟧: monochrome — single-color reproduction, another antonym
